Container.Name: Glassfin
Container.Overview: Glassfin is a glass-themed PWA media client for Jellyfin. Browser → Jellyfin direct, no backend. Optional Sonarr/Radarr integration for "request missing titles" from search. Configure via env vars; no rebuilds needed.
Container.Requires: A reachable Jellyfin server. The browser must be able to hit JELLYFIN_URL directly — see the project's deploy/REMOTE_ACCESS.md for CORS guidance.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Glassfin web UI

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_URL
Config.Description: Browser-reachable Jellyfin base URL. The browser hits this directly — must be reachable from wherever you open Glassfin.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Auth-by-name (sign-in form) is the preferred path; this key is only for headless / fallback use.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_USER_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Pinned user UUID used with the API key fallback.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_APP_URL
Config.Description: External URL users open to reach Glassfin. Used by docs and ServerInfo.

Config.Name: REMOTE_ACCESS_MODE
Config.Description: lan, tailscale, or cloudflare. Drives the deploy-mode label only — doesn't change behaviour.

Config.Name: SONARR_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Set to enable 'Request via Sonarr' on search empty state. Browser-reachable Sonarr base URL.

Config.Name: SONARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Sonarr API key from Settings → General → Security in the Sonarr UI.

Config.Name: RADARR_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Set to enable 'Request via Radarr' on search empty state. Browser-reachable Radarr base URL.

Config.Name: RADARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Radarr API key from Settings → General → Security in the Radarr UI.
